additional_info.subject: URGENT HIGH PRIORIY SiD: 170001509: Charger did not recover after V6.0.3 OTA update
additional_info.body:
Dear Expert,
Sicharge D
MP / R2 170001509
this unit was doing OTA update this morning 20
th
Aug 2025 GMT+8 to V6.0.23 (From V5.0.23)
But it nv came back.
The charger is showing black screen, white blinking LED
I am not able to get connection to the system via companion tool, unable to get FW version
I can connect to the router which is showing connected with Mobile.
SCB is showing FW updating.
Please help!
Thank you
Edna Seah

additional_info.subject: ID0444918-DC/Si-D/TH-[MP / R2 170001509] Black Screen Issue CRM:02699000191
additional_info.body:
Hello Edna, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well today.
I checked in SCB and it mentions v7.0.5. Is the HMI still not working? If no:
Have you tested replacing the DP cable?
Checked the 24V supply to the PCB controller?
Updated the HMI software?
If after all this, it's still not working, then please proceed with the replacement.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
